title: Online Registrations for Yuva Sangam Phase VII Commence from 4 August 2026
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Education

Online Registrations for Yuva Sangam Phase VII Commence from 4 August 2026

Ministry of Education opens online registrations for Yuva Sangam Phase VII
20 Higher Education Institutions to lead youth exchange programmes under Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
04 AUG 2026 7:15PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Education today opened the online registration portal for
Yuva Sangam Phase VII
 under the
Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat (EBSB)
 initiative. Interested youth aged 18–30 years, including students of Higher Education Institutions, NSS/NYKS volunteers, and young professionals, are eligible to register through the official portal at

https://ebsb.aicte-india.org

The last date of registration for Yuva Sangam Phase VII is Aug 18, 2026.

For Yuva Sangam Phase VII, 20 Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), that is, IITs, IIMs, Central Universities and NITs have been identified as nodal institutions to host and facilitate the exchange programme. Selected participants will undertake five to seven day educational and cultural tours (excluding travel days) to their paired States/UTs, where they will gain firsthand exposure to local traditions, educational institutions, governance initiatives, innovation ecosystems, industries, heritage sites, and community life.

Yuva Sangam is a flagship Youth Exchange Programme of the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, aimed at strengthening emotional bonds and fostering mutual understanding among young citizens from different States and Union Territories. The initiative promotes the spirit of "Unity in Diversity" by facilitating structured exposure visits between paired States and Union Territories, enabling participants to experience India's rich cultural, linguistic, educational and developmental diversity firsthand.

The programme is structured around the five thematic pillars (5 Ps) of Paryatan (Tourism), Parampara (Traditions & Culture), Pragati (Development & Governance), Paraspar Sampark (People-to-People Connect), and Prodyogiki (Technology & Innovation). Through these thematic engagements, participants develop a deeper appreciation of India's cultural diversity while fostering mutual understanding and national unity, in alignment with the vision of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.

Yuva Sangam is implemented through a collaborative "Whole of Government" approach with active support from participating Ministries, Departments, State Governments and partner Higher Education Institutions. The previous editions of the programme have witnessed overwhelming participation from youth across the country.

The Ministry of Education encourages youth from across the country to seize this unique opportunity to experience India's vibrant diversity, interact with peers from different regions, and become ambassadors of the Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat vision.
